title: elymus arenarius subsp. sabulosus
intro: Elymus arenarius subsp. sabulosus, commonly known as Sand Couch Grass or Sand Lyme Grass, is a subspecies of the Elymus arenarius plant, a type of grass that is native to coastal areas in Europe and Western Asia. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce stress and improve overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Elymus arenarius subsp. sabulosus include its ability to soothe and calm the nervous system, making it a potential natural remedy for anxiety and insomnia. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
